title: Outcome-Classified Precision Auditing of Filter Rules in Algorithmic DEX Trading: Evidence from 2,400 Rejection Events
abstract: arXiv:2607.02830v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper reports a precision audit of a production filter stack against a 13-day window of post-rejection forward-market observations on Solana DEX trading (2026-04-10 to 2026-04-23, UTC). The audit yielded 99,510 follow-up samples across 2,402 unique rejection events spanning eight active filter rules. We classify each event under a five-tier outcome rule and report per-filter distributions. The descriptive result is a save-to-miss ratio of 3.7 : 1 (418 windowed measured-drawdown saves against 112 misses). This ratio is a descriptive count, not by itself evidence of filter skill: a fair-game price path also reaches a 50 percent drawdown before a 100 percent rise more often than the reverse, and a rebuilt analysis supersedes it. Correction (October 2026): I withdraw the early-death tier, the wider 14.8 : 1 ratio that rested on it, and the matched lifecycle comparison (48.9 versus 57.6 percent of mints reaching the gone state). translated_title: 基于结果分类的算法化去中心化交易所（DEX）交易过滤器规则精确审计：来自2,400个拒绝事件的证据
translated_abstract: 本文报告了一项针对生产环境过滤器堆栈的精确审计，审计基于Solana DEX交易中13天的拒绝后前向市场观察窗口（2026年4月10日至2026年4月23日，UTC时间）。此次审计产生了99,510个后续样本，涵盖2,402个独特的拒绝事件，涉及八条活跃的过滤器规则。我们依据五级结果规则对每个事件进行分类，并报告每条过滤器的分布情况。描述性结果显示“挽救与错过”之比为3.7:1（418次窗口化测量的回撤挽救对应112次错过）。该比率仅为描述性计数，本身并不能证明过滤器的有效性：在公平博弈的价格路径下，价格先达到50%回撤而非先上涨100%的情形本身就更常出现，且一项重建的分析已取代该结果。更正（2026年10月）：作者撤回“早亡”层级、建立在该层级上的14.8:1比率，以及匹配的生命周期比较结果（48.9%对57.6%的代币发行达到“消失”状态）。
tldr: 本文通过对Solana DEX算法交易中2,402个过滤器拒绝事件进行五级结果分类的精确审计，报告了3.7:1的描述性“挽救-错过”比率，但作者在更正中撤回了此前更强的结论，强调该比率本身无法证明过滤器的实际有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts an outcome-classified precision audit of filter rules in algorithmic Solana DEX trading across 2,402 rejection events, reporting a descriptive 3.7:1 save-to-miss ratio while withdrawing earlier overstated claims in a correction, since the ratio alone does not demonstrate filter skill.
